notes.notes:
“Welcome to Astral Party!”



Dear players!

Dear Players, the game will undergo an update on September 28th, 2025 at 15:00 (UTC+8). Please log back into the game after the update is completed.

 

Update Time

2025/09/28 15:00 (UTC+8)



Update Content

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44669764/ca9dacb1f8a26fee1d1478f7c912f3cbb5361219.png"]
[olist]
 Collaboration Characters from VA-11 HALL-A: Cyberpunk Bartender Action Available — 2025/09/28 ~ 2025/11/30

The collaboration between Astral Party and VA-11 HALL-A: Cyberpunk Bartender Action will officially launch on September 28th!

In this collaboration, two popular characters from VA-11 HALL-A: Cyberpunk Bartender Action — Jill Stingray and Dorothy Haze — will join Astral Party as limited-edition characters!

Participate in the collaboration event to collect the token \[Shaker], which can be used to freely redeem the character Jill Stingray and various rich rewards!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44669764/965ba74c9231c56639ec4578e158f92489bebbba.png"]

New Map: \[Phantom Alley]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44669764/6fd0ba3f5c08ff5b86cd3ebca42859a20d61328b.png"]

Masao has created some weird inventions this time, which have turned the nice party into a mess. This is unforgivable — we must stop her! Wait… but she’s flying in the air… Let’s first deal with her inventions!

Key Mechanic:Characters will be inflicted with the "Modified" state by monsters. If not removed within a certain time, terrible consequences will follow! But don’t worry — find the Quirky Candy Machine to buy magical candies to counter this!

New Monsters:Frankenstein, Synthetic-Apocalypse, Synthetic-Omen, Synthetic-Chaos, Jack-in-the-Monkey, Buzzsaw Monkey Assistant , Mad Ape.

New Tile:Quirky Candy Machine

Map-Exclusive Cards:Support Gum, Energy Bar , Smartie Gummy



New Event: \[S6 - Monster Masquerade (First Half)] — 2025/09/28 ~ 2025/10/31

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44669764/0e8989a3934f33f0d81350a1e3c5057f4fe5220b.png"]

Players can access the event from the main screen. Complete event tasks to obtain \[Lightning Snow Globe], which can be used in the corresponding gacha pool to draw the grand prize skin — Mad Scientist - Fanny.



New Event: Sky Explorer Assistant - Z3000 — 2025/10/06 ~ 2025/10/31

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44669764/c3243edd9b3dd7a164e13c3aae79785452201695.png"]

Players can access the event from the main screen. Complete event tasks to obtain \[Data Chip], which can be used in the event shop to redeem rewards such as the skin Sky Explorer Assistant - Z3000.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44669764/942a3b169a2237ad1512f8dc2432ced006f16f7f.png"]

New Event: Syndicate Prince UP! — 2025/09/28 ~ 2025/10/31

Players can check the relevant tab in "Gacha". There will be a higher probability of obtaining the featured character in the "Syndicate Prince UP" tab.



New Event: Oasis Queen UP! — 2025/09/28 ~ 2025/10/31

Players can check the relevant tab in "Gacha". There will be a higher probability of obtaining the featured character in the "Oasis Queen UP" tab.



New Event: Z3000 UP! — 2025/09/28 ~ 2025/10/31

Players can check the relevant tab in "Gacha". There will be a higher probability of obtaining the featured character in the "Z3000 UP" tab.



Shop Update

New festive-themed skins now available:Twilight Witch - Nardis, Little Nurse - Teru, Ketchup Magic AL

Launch of the value-discounted \[Festival Flair Pack], which includes 3 festive-themed skins. The price will automatically deduct the cost of any skins you already own — Event Period: 2025/09/28 ~ 2025/10/31

"Co-op Challenge Level Boost Pack"  now available in the Package Shop — Event Period: 2025/09/28 ~ 2025/11/30

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44669764/f87b5f8079d2f89466143c36e8670f59c41b1188.png"]

System Optimizations

The Monster Encyclopedia now displays the amount of Star Coins obtained after defeating a monster.

If a product corresponding to a cosmetic has been removed from the shelf, its acquisition path will no longer redirect

Enabling Vertical Sync (VSync) will lock the frame rate

Daily tasks in event tasks will now display the "Daily Reset" text.

 When manually refreshing chips in Co-op Challenge Mode, chips that did not appear last time will be prioritized.

Optimized the chip appearance logic in Co-op Challenge Mode.

Optimized the display of the \[Profile Card - Heatwave Shores].

Optimized the damage calculation display of the Midnight Flash skill.

 Optimized some animations of the Katana User Bond Skin.



Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where the Friend System might cause the game to freeze.

Fixed an issue where the completion status of some event tasks was abnormal.

Fixed an issue where the number of Remote Dice in hand was abnormal after Destiny Girl’s Potential Awakening and using her active skill.

Fixed an issue where the list display in the Encyclopedia System was abnormal.

Fixed an issue where the Command Platform lacked an encounter image after Z3000 used its active skill on it.

Fixed an issue with the BGM audio channel.

 Fixed an issue where the amount of Star Coins obtained from Destiny Girl’s active skill was abnormal.
[/olist]


Maintenance Reward

This update and maintenance will distribute --- 【Gacha Cassette X 3】.

The mail is valid for 7X24 hours.

Wish you a pleasant game, and thank you for your continued support of "Astral Party".

 

Astral Party Operation Team

notes.title: 【Preview】Astral Party Update (0905)
notes.notes:
“Welcome to Astral Party!”



Dear players!

The game will undergo an update on September 5th, 2025 at 15:00 (UTC+8).
Once the update is complete, please log in again to continue playing.

 

Update Time

September 5th, 2025, 15:00 (UTC+8)



Update Content
[olist]
New Event – Resource Week Event!
Event Period: 2025/09/05 ~ 2025/09/19
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44669764/c2e72e0d56f2e80f34a4981d70d895b39d4c1e30.png"]
Players can enter the event from the main menu. Complete various missions to earn generous rewards such as \[color=#BA1FFF] Shiyu-Shiyu Chip \[/color] ×1150.



Potential Activation

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44669764/62d94e02b6cfc0c939511a6151f4f957612917c8.png"]

New characters with unlockable potential: Shadow Ninja, Waste-Collecting Robot, and Destiny Girl.

 Shadow Ninja Potential Activation:

 For every 3 Effect Cards used, the CD of the current active skill -1, and permanently increase Effect Card damage by +1.

Waste-Collecting Robot Potential Activation:

For every 2 monsters defeated, permanently gain +1 Attack Power.

When Attack Power is greater than 6, you can attack monsters pulled by active skills.

Destiny Girl Potential Activation:

When a monster with \[Weakness Mark] is defeated, the character who defeats it gains 1 card \[Guidance of Fate].

When using an active skill, replace \[Smart Dice] in your hand with \[Guidance of Fate].

Guidance of Fate Effect:

Next movement points can be chosen freely between 1–6.

Current skill CD -1.

Gain +1 card play count this turn.

(This preview is for reference only. Final details are subject to the actual update.)



Shop Updates

Paid Shop: “Co-op Challenge 7-Day Support Pack” available 2025/09/05 ~ 2025/10/06

Bundle Shop: “Magic Gem” Pack available 2025/09/05 ~ 2025/10/06



Optimizations & Adjustments

Increased Shiyu-Shiyu Chip gained from Co-op Challenge victories:

Normal: 30 → 35

Hard: 36 → 45

Extreme: 75 → 80

At the end of Co-op Challenge mode victories, for each Newbie player (account level below 10), all team members gain an additional +10 Shiyu-Shiyu Chip and +10 Coins.

Optimized the confirmation popup UI and flow when purchasing items.

Added V-Sync toggle to the settings menu (PC client only).



Important Notice
Thank you for supporting Astral Party!
Preparations for the CN server release are currently underway. To ensure consistency between the Steam and CN versions (as well as future cross-version alignment), adjustments will be made to currency recharge and some direct-purchase items on the Steam version starting September 5th.

Recharge Adjustments:

Recharge now grants \[Golden Star Disc].

First-time recharge also grants \[Star Disc].

\[Golden Star Disc] can be exchanged 1:1 for \[Star Disc].

The following direct-purchase items will now require \[Golden Star Disc]:

Shop skins, skin bundles, direct-purchase packs, direct-purchase outfits.

The following items will remain as direct-purchase:

Monthly Pass, 7-Day Pack, Clear Pass, and Collaboration Items.

All items that were previously purchased with \[Star Disc] remain unchanged.



Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where the friend list did not display all friends when scrolling with the mouse wheel.

Fixed abnormal jump links for some outfits.

Fixed an issue where the character \[Quirky Detective] caused incorrect shop card counts after triggering the Bargain Sale event post-Potential Activation.

Fixed BGM playback issues on the maps \[Dragon Palace Amusement Park] and \[Magic Academy].

Fixed an issue where the character \[Cyber Phantom] discarded cards abnormally on \[Dragon Palace Amusement Park].

Fixed an issue where the \[Adrenaline] chip failed to check conditions correctly when character HP changed.
[/olist]




Maintenance Reward

This update and maintenance will distribute --- 【Gacha Cassette X 3】.

The mail is valid for 7X24 hours.

Wish you a pleasant game, and thank you for your continued support of "Astral Party".

 

Astral Party Operation Team

notes.title: 【Preview】July 4th Version Update
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44669764/119fa51992d841f2ba502462dc0a24c89d124ade.png"]

“Welcome to Astral Party!”

Update Details
[olist]
New Co-Op Challenge Map: \[Dragon Palace Amusement Park]

Legends tell of a treasure hidden within the Dragon Palace that grants the power to become a true dragon. But there is only one relic—and two girls who need it. You can only choose one to support!



New Gameplay Mechanics:

Players have to defeat two elite monsters to collect key items, then cast your vote to support one of the girls. The other will appear as the opposing Boss.

 

New Monster Intro: Dragon Palace Amusement Park

Amakawa Mamushi (BOSS)

Active Skill: Makes all players within a certain range lose one effect card. If a player has too few hand cards, the Jiao will deal damage to the player.

Passive Skill: Enhances herself when taking damage. If a player deals massive damage in one attack, the enhancement will be removed and stop using skills.

Amakawa Souri (BOSS)

Active Skill: Summons Golden Fish.

Passive Skill: Enhances herself when counterattacking.

Loudmouth (Elite)

Active Skill: Uses range attack

Passive Skill: Cannot move. When Martial Trainee being defeated, Loudmouth will power up and able to counterattack.

Martial Trainee (Elite)

Passive Skill: Cannot move. When Loudmouth being defeated, Martial Trainee will power up and able to move

Prawn Soldier

Passive Skill: Has additional effect when attacking the player who has too few hand cards.

Golden Fish

Active Skill: Enhances Amakawa Souri (BOSS)

Crab Soldier

Passive Skill: Increases ATK when receiving damage.



Skill Intro: New Character “Hierarch of Mikami - Teru”

Co-Op Challenge Mode:

Active Skill:

Chooses a target player to apply “Divine Invocation”. Incresing Teru’s ATK and DEF based on the target. Consuming “Fire Fox” to assist players in pursuing attack

Passive Skill:

When Teru or the player with Divine Invocation plays high-cost attack battle cards,  gaining 1 stack of 'Fox Fire'. 'Fox Fire' increases her pursuing attack damage.

Standard Battle Mode

Active Skill:

Choose another character to apply "Divine Descent", increase own attack and defense based on target's attack and defense, and steal target's star coins based on 'Fox Fire' stacks.

Passive Skill:

When self or player with Divine Descent plays high-cost attack cards, stack 'Fox Fire'.



First Batch Character Potential Activation Introduction:

Quirky Detective

When using active skills, choose 1 of 2 random events to trigger.

Shy Nun

After using active skills, cannot take damage this turn and cannot be counterattacked.

Uncle Employee

On a roll of 6, ignore opponent's DEF. When rolling less than 2, your next attack roll is automatically 6."

Pro Gamer

When applying Shiyu-Shiyu Shield to a character, additionally grant the target one counterattack.

Kanban Musume

Gains 1 chip for every certain number of cards accumulated.

Katana Master

Active skill range increased.When sword energy is full and using active skills, consume sword energy to gain 1 \[Legendary Sword: Gawu Cut].Your \[Legendary Sword: Gawu Cut] costs 1 less.


[/olist]
Note: Content may vary at release.



Thank you for supporting Astral Party!



The Astral Party Operations Team
